# eon_restore_s3_buckets (Data Source)

Lists S3 buckets available to a restore account.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "eon_restore_s3_buckets" "example" {
  restore_account_id = "restore-account-id"
}

output "restore_s3_buckets" {
  value = data.eon_restore_s3_buckets.example.buckets
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `restore_account_id` (String) Eon restore account ID.

### Read-Only

- `buckets` (Attributes List) S3 buckets available to the restore account. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--buckets))

<a id="nestedatt--buckets"></a>
### Nested Schema for `buckets`

Read-Only:

- `bucket_name` (String) S3 bucket name.
- `region_name` (String) AWS region containing the bucket.
